Legal

Privacy Notice

This notice describes which personal data is processed when you visit this website and when you get in touch. The privacy notice must accurately reflect the services and data processing actually used.

Controller

Niklas Heinzmann, NAHX Technologies, Musterstraße 1, 12345 Musterstadt, email: hello@nahx-technologies.example

Hosting and server log files

The website is static and loads no external scripts, fonts or analytics services and stores nothing in the browser. When pages are requested, the hosting provider processes technically necessary data (IP address, time, page requested, browser) in server log files. Hosting: provider and location to follow. Retention: 7 days. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Getting in touch

If you contact me by email, the information submitted (sender address, name, content of the message) is processed to handle the enquiry and stored for as long as necessary for that purpose. There is no contact form. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Competent authority: data protection authority of the federal state of residence.

Note

The marked details are test data. This page will be adapted to the services actually used and reviewed before launch. Not legal advice.
